_notes: student/mobile CROSS_BORDER_VERIFICATION.summary: the old Vietnamese listed 'items transferred, timing, retention' (likely from the Korean PIPA wording); aligned to the reviewed English ('Details, including how to refuse') — owner to confirm the Korean legal text does not require the longer list.

Document review: student-facing strings now use one verb, 'kiểm tra' (was mixed xem xét / duyệt / kiểm tra); agency-facing strings keep the staff verb 'duyệt', which is natural for a review queue. Owner may prefer a single verb across both products.

'Hangyul team': the English now says Hangyul team everywhere; Vietnamese strings that said 'chuyên viên tư vấn' / 'tư vấn viên' (counselor) were re-aligned. Left 'chuyên viên tư vấn' where the English itself says counselor (university console).

Managed application: three different renderings (quản lý hồ sơ / hồ sơ được quản lý / hồ sơ Hangyul cùng bạn quản lý) unified to 'Hồ sơ Hangyul nộp cùng bạn' — says what we do (prepare and submit with the student), no promise.

'contracted documents' (v29 unrationed + premiumEditing): 'hồ sơ' would read as 'application'; used neutral 'tài liệu trong hợp đồng'. If these are strictly the personal statement / study plan, owner may prefer 'bài luận trong hợp đồng'.

Standard admission letter kept as the existing locale convention 'giấy báo nhập học tiêu chuẩn' (표준입학허가서); offer stays 'thư mời nhập học'. 'apostille' lower-cased everywhere per glossary (locale was mixed).
mobile:settings.elsewhere 'Elsewhere' rendered as 'Ngoài ứng dụng' (outside the app) because the section lists things done on the web; a literal 'Ở nơi khác' reads as a location.

Arrival checklist CTAs (student + mobile) kept the existing 'danh sách chuẩn bị nhập cảnh' wording and made identical; 'nhập cảnh' is how Vietnamese students refer to the go-to-Korea step, though it literally means entry.
mobile:v3.home.noCounselor: 'in your language' was hard-coded as 'tiếng Việt'; restored to 'ngôn ngữ của bạn' so the string is true for any Vietnamese-reading user.
mobile:v29.mfa.enrollOnWeb: 'web console' rendered 'bảng điều khiển web', matching mobile:v3.settings.consoleHint.
